name: corra_overnight_spread_bps
notes: Daily CORRA minus daily overnight rate target, in basis points. Inputs: AVG.INTWO (CORRA daily) and V39079 (overnight rate, daily). Overnight target forward-filled across non-publication days. Positive values = CORRA trades above target; near-zero = floor regime functioning. 20-day smoothing applied at chart layer, not here.
